title: Nelson Freeman Jackson
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Nelson Freeman Jackson." Historical Document Record (2002). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Funeral program cover: 'In Loving Memory of Nelson Freeman Jackson - September 25, 1963 - October 3, 2002 - Saturday, October 12, 2002 - Dixon Chapel Church, Millsboro, Delaware - Officiating: Elder Mack Kendricks, Sanford, Fl.' Photograph collage of Nelson Freeman Jackson on the cover. He is Freeman Nelson Jackson's brother (Nelson Jackson, 'Toe-Joe'), son of Mary Elizabeth Lingard and Nelson Freeman Thompson, Sr. Photographed and supplied by Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23.
